name: Silicosis Financial Assistance Scheme
benefit: **Financial Assistance:** ₹1,00,000/- (one lakh rupees) per case. **Purpose:** Financial assistance to heirs of deceased workers who died due to silicosis. **Nature:** One-time payment as compensation.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be the legal heir of a deceased person who was engaged in Akik occupation. - The applicant must be the heir of a self-reliant person who carried on occupation of Akik in Gujarat state. - The applicant must be the heir of a person who died due to serious disease of silicosis. - The applicant must be the heir of a worker whose death occurred due to occupational silicosis while engaged in Akik work. - The applicant must establish the occupational nature of the silicosis disease in relation to Akik work.
